extracted.intended_audience: members of the press / journalists / media outlets
extracted.subtask_description: Resources and expectations for press coverage and press releases from a local Habitat for Humanity chapter, including available media assets, contact points, messaging points, and eligibility criteria for partner families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved logo variations and program descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional resources, such as approved logo variations and program descriptions, are available to members of the news media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for branding assets and official program descriptions should be sent to newsroom@habitateco.org so press materials use approved logos and wording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Habitat for Humanity media contacts and asset availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat for Humanity can offer the news media high-quality Habitat photography and video as well as quotes and interviews about Habitat’s work and related subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a media contact in press materials and direct requests for photos, video, quotes, or interviews to newsroom@habitateco.org; indicate spokesperson availability and multimedia access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage press to sign up for news alerts
rubrics_metrics.description: Members of the press are encouraged to sign up for Habitat Newsroom for alerts of newsworthy releases from Habitat for Humanity East Central Ohio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an easy sign-up for news notifications so journalists receive timely press releases and updates (the page says 'Click here to sign up for notifications').

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear headline and date on press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases are presented with a clear title and a publication date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each release should include an obvious headline and the date (as shown in the 'Recent Press Releases' list) to make it easy for newsrooms to identify timeliness and subject.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link and attribute media coverage ('In the News')
rubrics_metrics.description: The newsroom lists 'In the News' items showing article title, date, and source (e.g., The Canton Repository).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When aggregating or referencing coverage, provide links, the outlet name, and the publication date so readers and other journalists can verify and follow up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connect releases to Habitat's mission and community impact
rubrics_metrics.description: The Newsroom exists to provide 'what you’ll need to connect with the mission and community-changing work of Habitat for Humanity East Central Ohio.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame press releases around mission, community benefit, and concrete impact (milestones, partnerships, beneficiary stories) to communicate relevance to local audiences and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family qualification — Ability to Pay
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible to purchase a Habitat home, potential homeowners must demonstrate steady income; 'Ability to Pay.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press materials that describe homeowner selection should state that Habitat homes are sold with a zero-interest mortgage and that families must show steady income (homes are not given away).

rubrics_metrics.name: Family qualification — Need for Decent, Affordable Housing
rubrics_metrics.description: A family must be currently living in sub-standard housing; 'Need for Decent, Affordable Housing.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing partner families, make clear eligibility is based on current housing need and that Habitat focuses on providing decent, affordable housing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family qualification — Willingness to Partner (Sweat Equity)
rubrics_metrics.description: A family must have the willingness to partner with Habitat by investing hundreds of hours of sweat equity in their home and the homes of other families.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explanations of 'sweat equity' and the volunteer/time commitments required of partner families when profiling homeowners or explaining the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-benefit messaging points
rubrics_metrics.description: How Communities Benefit — a set of messaging points describing the broader benefits when communities are strengthened by Habitat work (property tax payers; connecting volunteers to those they help; faith-based service; improving homeownership rates; overcoming blight; volunteer team-building).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these specific themes as talking points in press releases and backgrounders: (1) Habitat homeownership creates property taxpayers; (2) Habitat connects volunteers/donors directly to local families; (3) Habitat offers an avenue to put faith into service; (4) committed home buyers improve the homeownership base; (5) invested homeowners help overcome blight; (6) volunteering develops team-building skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include clear calls to action
rubrics_metrics.description: The site presents explicit actions: Volunteer, Donate, Own a Home, ReStore.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press materials should include clear CTAs and links for how readers can get involved (volunteer sign-up, donate link, information on owning a Habitat home, ReStore donation/shopping info).
